item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las gtsang bud med rtog 'joms ye shes rang grol
item.coloph: zhes kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal du 'bod pa gsang bdag ye shes mgon po zhes bya ba bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i lung gis dkrol ('khrol) bzhin yi ger phab pa dge'o//
